[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Outerknown: Focuses on recycled materials and fair labor practices (prices range from $20-$200).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Reformation: Popular for sustainable, high-quality clothing (average price point: $50-$200).

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Outlet stores for discounted prices on past-season styles.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Consignment stores for gently used designer items.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Clothing rental services like Rent the Runway or Vestiaire Collective.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Look for sales and discounts on favorite designer brands' websites and social media.
